<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<style>
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:#f4f2ef;width:304px;height:300px}
canvas{display:block;position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:304px;height:300px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const W = 304, H = 300, ZS = 0.85, PERIOD = 740;
const LIFT_A = 2.05, LIFT_B = 2.45;

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(W, H);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color('#f4f2ef');

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(25, W / H, 0.1, 100);
camera.position.set(0, 1.9, 6.766);
camera.lookAt(0, 1.9, 0);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xf0e8d8, 1.9));
const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.25); key.position.set(-1.5, 3, 6); scene.add(key);
const back = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.9); back.position.set(1.5, 2.5, -6); scene.add(back);
const sl = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.45); sl.position.set(-6, 1.5, 0.5); scene.add(sl);
const sr = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.45); sr.position.set(6, 1.5, 0.5); scene.add(sr);

const sm = (a, b, x) => { const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a))); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };

const YEL = new THREE.Color('#ffd02a');
const WH = new THREE.Color('#ffffff');

const yellowMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: YEL, roughness: 0.75, metalness: 0 });
const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.75, metalness: 0 });

function lathe(pts, seg = 96) {
  const curve = new THREE.SplineCurve(pts.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])));
  const sp = curve.getPoints(120).map(p => new THREE.Vector2(Math.max(0, p.x), p.y));
  sp[0].x = 0; sp[sp.length - 1].x = 0;
  const g = new THREE.LatheGeometry(sp, seg);
  g.scale(1, 1, ZS);
  return g;
}

// ---------- character ----------
const character = new THREE.Group();
character.name = 'character-blob';
scene.add(character);

const bodyGroup = new THREE.Group(); bodyGroup.name = 'body';
character.add(bodyGroup);
const bodyGeo = lathe([
  [0, 0], [0.65, 0.06], [1.05, 0.25], [1.26, 0.5], [1.32, 0.8], [1.32, 1.1], [1.27, 1.4],
  [1.17, 1.7], [0.98, 2.0], [0.78, 2.2], [0.645, 2.32], [0.565, 2.42], [0.53, 2.52],
  [0.45, 2.6], [0.27, 2.66], [0, 2.68]
]);
{
  // belly patch: white at the top, fading to cream / yellow toward the bottom
  const pos = bodyGeo.attributes.position;
  const col = new Float32Array(pos.count * 3);
  const c = new THREE.Color();
  for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
    const x = pos.getX(i), y = pos.getY(i), z = pos.getZ(i);
    const d = Math.pow(Math.abs(x) / 1.06, 2.4) + Math.pow(Math.abs(y - 1.3) / 0.845, 2.4);
    let t = 1 - sm(0.6, 1.08, d);
    t *= sm(0.0, 0.35, z);
    t *= sm(0.45, 1.4, y);
    c.copy(YEL).lerp(WH, t);
    col[i * 3] = c.r; col[i * 3 + 1] = c.g; col[i * 3 + 2] = c.b;
  }
  bodyGeo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(col, 3));
}
const bodyBase = new Float32Array(bodyGeo.attributes.position.array);
const bodyMesh = new THREE.Mesh(bodyGeo, bodyMat); bodyMesh.name = 'body-mesh';
bodyMesh.frustumCulled = false;
bodyGroup.add(bodyMesh);

// head
const head = new THREE.Group(); head.name = 'head';
head.position.set(0, 2.4, 0);
character.add(head);
const headGeo = lathe([
  [0, -0.28], [0.37, -0.24], [0.52, -0.15], [0.555, -0.04], [0.555, 0.05], [0.555, 0.22],
  [0.55, 0.38], [0.53, 0.53], [0.48, 0.66], [0.385, 0.76], [0.22, 0.825], [0, 0.85]
]);
const headMesh = new THREE.Mesh(headGeo, yellowMat); headMesh.name = 'head-mesh';
headMesh.frustumCulled = false;
head.add(headMesh);

// eyes
const eyes = new THREE.Group(); eyes.name = 'eyes';
head.add(eyes);
const irisMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#45c244', roughness: 0.45 });
const rimMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#2b7a2a', roughness: 0.6 });
const pupilMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#17331c', roughness: 0.35 });
const pupils = [];
function makeEye(name, sx) {
  const g = new THREE.Group(); g.name = name;
  const x = sx * 0.30, y = 0.47, r = 0.54;
  const z = ZS * Math.sqrt(r * r - x * x);
  const n = new THREE.Vector3(x, 0.07, z / (ZS * ZS)).normalize();
  g.position.set(x, y, z).addScaledVector(n, -0.006);
  eyes.add(g);
  const rim = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.112, 28, 16), rimMat);
  rim.scale.z = 0.2; rim.name = name + '-rim'; g.add(rim);
  const iris = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.103, 28, 16), irisMat);
  iris.scale.z = 0.3; iris.name = name + '-iris'; g.add(iris);
  const pg = new THREE.Group(); pg.name = name + '-pupil'; g.add(pg);
  const pupil = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.06, 24, 14), pupilMat);
  pupil.scale.z = 0.3; pupil.position.z = 0.02; pg.add(pupil);
  pupils.push(pg);
  scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  const target = g.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3()).add(n);
  g.lookAt(target);
  return g;
}
makeEye('eye-left', -1);
makeEye('eye-right', 1);

// mouth
const mouth = new THREE.Group(); mouth.name = 'mouth';
head.add(mouth);
{
  const pts = [];
  const r = 0.554, hw = 0.215;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 24; i++) {
    const x = -hw + 2 * hw * i / 24;
    const u = Math.abs(x) / hw;
    const y = 0.235 + 0.04 * u * u * u;
    const z = ZS * Math.sqrt(r * r - x * x) + 0.003;
    pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z));
  }
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts);
  const mm = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 48, 0.009, 8, false),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#7a5210', roughness: 0.8 })
  );
  mm.name = 'mouth-line';
  mouth.add(mm);
}

// arms (their vertices follow the same squash/stretch field as the body)
const SH = new THREE.Vector3(0.67, 2.25, 0.10);
const HAND = new THREE.Vector3(1.195, 1.08, 0.25);
const ARM_PTS = [
  [0.67, 2.25, 0.10], [0.95, 1.97, 0.14], [1.11, 1.62, 0.19], [1.19, 1.30, 0.22], [1.195, 1.08, 0.25]
];
const arms = [];
function makeArm(side, sx) {
  const g = new THREE.Group(); g.name = 'arm-' + side;
  const ox = sx * SH.x, oy = SH.y, oz = SH.z;
  g.position.set(ox, oy, oz);
  const pts = ARM_PTS.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(sx * p[0] - ox, p[1] - oy, p[2] - oz));
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts);
  const R = 0.16;
  const tubeGeo = new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 28, R, 16, false);
  const tube = new THREE.Mesh(tubeGeo, yellowMat);
  tube.name = 'arm-' + side + '-mesh';
  tube.frustumCulled = false;
  g.add(tube);
  const capGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(R, 18, 14);
  const cap = new THREE.Mesh(capGeo, yellowMat);
  cap.name = 'shoulder-' + side;
  cap.frustumCulled = false;
  g.add(cap);
  const deform = [];
  for (const geo of [tubeGeo, capGeo]) {
    const p = geo.attributes.position.array;
    const base = new Float32Array(p.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 3) {
      base[i] = p[i] + ox; base[i + 1] = p[i + 1] + oy; base[i + 2] = p[i + 2] + oz;
    }
    deform.push({ geo, base });
  }
  const hg = new THREE.Group(); hg.name = 'hand-' + side;
  hg.position.copy(pts[pts.length - 1]);
  const hand = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.17, 20, 16), yellowMat);
  hand.scale.set(1, 1.08, 1);
  hand.frustumCulled = false;
  hg.add(hand);
  g.add(hg);
  character.add(g);
  arms.push({ g, sx, deform, hg });
  return g;
}
makeArm('left', -1);
makeArm('right', 1);

// feet
const footMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#f4b416', roughness: 0.75 });
const feet = [];
function makeFoot(side, sx) {
  const g = new THREE.Group(); g.name = 'foot-' + side;
  g.position.set(sx * 0.5, 0.09, 0.72);
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 24, 16), footMat);
  m.scale.set(0.36, 0.11, 0.45);
  g.add(m);
  character.add(g);
  feet.push({ g, sx });
}
makeFoot('left', -1);
makeFoot('right', 1);

// ---------- animation keyframes ----------
// [t, py, sy, wLow, wMid, wSh, wHigh, headSY, tilt, pupil, lift]
const KEYS = [
  [0,    0.00, 1.00, 1.000, 1.000, 1.00, 1.00, 1.00,  0.00, 1.00, 0.000],
  [100, -0.07, 1.05, 1.055, 1.030, 0.97, 1.16, 1.05,  0.06, 1.00, 0.000],
  [200,  0.00, 1.01, 0.895, 0.905, 0.94, 1.06, 1.00, -0.10, 1.00, 0.000],
  [300,  0.00, 1.01, 0.895, 0.900, 0.94, 1.06, 1.00, -0.10, 1.00, 0.000],
  [420,  0.08, 0.94, 0.945, 0.780, 0.74, 0.92, 1.00, -0.08, 1.00, 0.160],
  [520,  0.09, 0.94, 0.930, 0.770, 0.71, 0.86, 1.00, -0.06, 1.08, 0.166],
  [620,  0.10, 0.94, 0.920, 0.765, 0.70, 0.83, 1.00, -0.10, 1.25, 0.211],
  [720,  0.09, 0.94, 0.935, 0.775, 0.72, 0.89, 1.00, -0.10, 1.10, 0.167],
  [740,  0.00, 1.00, 1.000, 1.000, 1.00, 1.00, 1.00,  0.00, 1.00, 0.000]
];
const NP = 11;
const P = new Array(NP).fill(0);
function sample(t) {
  let tt = t % PERIOD; if (tt < 0) tt += PERIOD;
  let i = 0;
  while (i < KEYS.length - 2 && tt >= KEYS[i + 1][0]) i++;
  const a = KEYS[i], b = KEYS[i + 1];
  const u = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (tt - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])));
  for (let k = 1; k < NP; k++) P[k] = a[k] + (b[k] - a[k]) * u;
  return P;
}

// horizontal scale of the body at height y (belly / chest / shoulders / neck)
function taper(y, wLow, wMid, wSh, wHigh) {
  if (y <= 1.7) return wLow + (wMid - wLow) * sm(0.5, 1.7, y);
  if (y <= 2.25) return wMid + (wSh - wMid) * sm(1.7, 2.25, y);
  return wSh + (wHigh - wSh) * sm(2.25, 2.45, y);
}

function pose(t) {
  const p = sample(t);
  const py = p[1], sy = p[2], wLow = p[3], wMid = p[4], wSh = p[5], wHigh = p[6];
  const headSY = p[7], tilt = p[8], pup = p[9], lift = p[10];

  character.position.y = py;
  character.scale.set(1, sy, 1);

  // body: radial taper + neck stretch
  const pos = bodyGeo.attributes.position;
  const arr = pos.array;
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 3) {
    const by = bodyBase[i + 1];
    const f = taper(by, wLow, wMid, wSh, wHigh);
    arr[i] = bodyBase[i] * f;
    arr[i + 1] = by + lift * sm(LIFT_A, LIFT_B, by);
    arr[i + 2] = bodyBase[i + 2] * f;
  }
  pos.needsUpdate = true;

  // head
  head.position.y = 2.4 + lift;
  head.scale.set(wHigh, headSY / sy, wHigh);
  head.rotation.set(tilt, 0, 0);

  // pupils
  for (const pg of pupils) pg.scale.set(pup, pup, 1);

  // arms follow the body deformation
  const fs = taper(SH.y, wLow, wMid, wSh, wHigh);
  const ls = lift * sm(LIFT_A, LIFT_B, SH.y);
  const fh = taper(HAND.y, wLow, wMid, wSh, wHigh);
  const lh = lift * sm(LIFT_A, LIFT_B, HAND.y);
  for (const a of arms) {
    const gx = a.sx * SH.x * fs, gy = SH.y + ls, gz = SH.z * fs;
    a.g.position.set(gx, gy, gz);
    for (const d of a.deform) {
      const pa = d.geo.attributes.position;
      const va = pa.array, base = d.base;
      for (let i = 0; i < va.length; i += 3) {
        const by = base[i + 1];
        const f = taper(by, wLow, wMid, wSh, wHigh);
        va[i] = base[i] * f - gx;
        va[i + 1] = by + lift * sm(LIFT_A, LIFT_B, by) - gy;
        va[i + 2] = base[i + 2] * f - gz;
      }
      pa.needsUpdate = true;
    }
    a.hg.position.set(a.sx * HAND.x * fh - gx, HAND.y + lh - gy, HAND.z * fh - gz);
    a.hg.scale.set(fh, 1, fh);
  }

  // feet
  for (const f of feet) f.g.position.x = f.sx * 0.5 * wLow;

  scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
}

function render(t) {
  pose(+t || 0);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
render(0);

window.nwb = {
  scene, renderer,
  cameras: { ref: camera },
  characters: [character],
  render,
  ready: true
};
</script>
</body>
</html>
